simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דָּשֵׁן (H1879) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: דָּשֵׁן (dâshên) means fat ; figuratively, rich , fertile First listed occurrence: Isa 30 23.

definitions.full: H1879. dashen דָּשֵׁן adjective fat , דָּשֵׁן Isa 30:23 (|| שָׁמֵן ), of לֶחֶם as product of ground; figurative of righteous as trees דְּשֵׁנִים Psa 92:15 (|| רעננים ) fat, full of oil (?) or sap (Che; compare דֶּשֶׁן Judg 9:9 ); as substantive vigorous, stalwart ones (opposed to עָפָר יוֺרְדֵי compare Che) Psa 22:30 אֶרֶץ דִּשְׁנֵיֿ (Brüll שֹׁכְנֵי , Ren Hist. iii. 134 ישְׁבֵי ).
